Official Documentation

Our Policies.

The foundation of trust and professional excellence within the Phanda Links marketplace.

1. Terms of Service2. Privacy Policy3. User Conduct Policy4. Worker Policy5. Client Policy6. Payments & Fees Policy7. Cancellation Policy8. Ratings & Reviews Policy9. Safety & Trust Policy10. Dispute Resolution Policy11. Credits & Rewards Policy12. Community Impact Policy

1. Terms of Service

This policy outlines the rules for using Phanda Links.

  • Users must be 18 years or older.
  • All information provided must be accurate and truthful.
  • Workers are independent service providers, not employees of Phanda Links.
  • Phanda Links acts as a platform connecting clients and workers.
  • Misuse of the platform may result in suspension or permanent bans.

2. Privacy Policy

We are committed to protecting user data.

What We Collect:

  • Personal details (name, contact info, ID verification)
  • Location data (for matching services)
  • Payment information
  • Usage data

How We Use It:

  • To connect users with nearby services
  • To improve app performance
  • To ensure safety and verification
  • To process payments

Commitment:

  • We do not sell user data.
  • All data is stored securely.
  • Users can request access or deletion of their data.

3. User Conduct Policy

All users must behave respectfully and responsibly.

Not Allowed:

  • Fraud or fake profiles
  • Harassment or abuse
  • Unsafe or illegal activities
  • Misrepresentation of skills or services

Violations may result in:

  • Account suspension
  • Permanent banning
  • Legal action (if necessary)

4. Worker Policy

This applies to all service providers on the platform.

Requirements:

  • Valid ID or verification documents
  • Honest listing of skills and experience
  • Professional conduct at all times

Expectations:

  • Arrive on time
  • Deliver agreed services
  • Maintain communication with clients

Accountability:

  • Poor ratings or misconduct may lead to removal from the platform.

5. Client Policy

This applies to all customers using the platform.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide accurate job descriptions
  • Ensure a safe working environment
  • Pay for services as agreed

Not Allowed:

  • Exploiting workers
  • Unsafe or illegal requests
  • Cancelling jobs unfairly

6. Payments & Fees Policy

Guidelines regarding financial transactions.

Payments:

  • All payments should be made through the app.
  • Secure payment gateways will be used.

Fees:

  • Phanda Links may charge a service fee or commission.

Refunds:

  • Service not delivered
  • Major disputes
  • Each case will be reviewed individually.

7. Cancellation Policy

Rules for cancelling scheduled services.

Clients:

  • Must cancel within a specified time window.
  • Late cancellations may incur a fee.

Workers:

  • Repeated cancellations may affect ratings and visibility.

8. Ratings & Reviews Policy

Ensuring honest and fair feedback.

  • Clients can rate workers after each job.
  • Workers may also rate clients.
  • Reviews must be honest and respectful.
  • Fake or abusive reviews will be removed.

9. Safety & Trust Policy

Phanda Links prioritizes safety.

Measures:

  • Identity verification
  • Rating system
  • Report & support system

Disclaimer:

  • While we aim to create a safe platform, users must exercise personal judgment and caution.

10. Dispute Resolution Policy

How we handle issues that arise.

Process:

  • Users report through the app
  • Phanda Links reviews the case
  • A fair resolution is provided

Possible outcomes:

  • Refunds
  • Account warnings
  • Suspensions

11. Credits & Rewards Policy

Worker incentives and benefits.

Workers earn credits based on:

  • Completed jobs
  • Good ratings
  • Consistency

Credits can be used for:

  • Profile boosts
  • Training opportunities
  • Platform benefits

12. Community Impact Policy

Our commitment to South Africa.

  • Supporting local economies
  • Promoting fair work practices
  • Encouraging youth employment
  • Creating sustainable opportunities

Connecting South African hustle to real opportunity. Visibility, dignity, and trust for every worker.
